hero_intro: Prisma Global Export is the international B2B trade-facing brand of PT Prisma Creative Indonesia. We welcome sourcing enquiries for Indonesian layered wooden wall art and selected product categories, subject to supplier verification, applicable permissions and destination-market requirements.
about_first: Prisma Global Export is the international-facing B2B brand operated by PT Prisma Creative Indonesia, a registered Indonesian company based in Tegal, Central Java. The legal entity is rooted in wood furniture manufacturing, alongside design and product-development interests.
about_second: We are building long-term conversations with overseas distributors, retailers and procurement teams. For any sourcing product outside the company’s currently licensed furniture activity, we first assess the necessary business authorisations, supplier capability and destination-market requirements.
